entries.effect: Spiritual Attrition: -3 to all SPI-based skill rolls and Beyonder ability checks
Spiritual Exhaustion: All Beyonder abilities deactivate; cannot activate any SPI-cost abilities; Spirit Vision shuts off
Soul Debt: +1 CoR per 1 point below 0 (e.g. SPI -4 = +4 CoR). See CoR (Chapter 6).
Roll 3d6 <= HT or fall unconscious; roll each turn to remain conscious
Roll vs. HT or die; must roll vs. HT each turn while below this threshold
